LanguageData.VV_Alert_ApocryphaChannelingDesc: Asphodel is drawing in the everflower's mana ({PROGRESS}, {TIMELEFT} remaining).\nIf the everflower is taken, the final bloom will be interrupted.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_ApocryphaRebirth: Though the giant hornet queen's form has collapsed and vanished, the cluster of lights left within has gathered to take shape once more. Countless fairy vivis wrap layer upon layer around Asphodel, the old empress; having temporarily regained a semblance of her past self, Asphodel will try to seize the everflower to carry out her own salvation.\n\nThe countless bound fairy vivis are taking every attack in her place. To stop the empress, attack and shatter her fairy veil, then have normal vivis resonate with the fairy blooms that sprout nearby and carry the tethered chain to the everflower altar to sever her bond with the fairy vivis.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaChannelInterrupted: Asphodel's usurpation of the everflower was interrupted.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaEscapedRoofCollapse: Asphodel teleported away from a roof collapse.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaShieldBroken: Asphodel's fairy veil has scattered, briefly stunning her as fairy blooms sprout nearby.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaShieldRestored: The fairy vivis have gathered once more, restoring Asphodel's fairy veil.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaResolveGained: A fairy bloom was destroyed by force, hardening Asphodel's resolve. ({0} stacks)
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaNeedleStuck: An ancient eltex needle lodged in her carapace, briefly stunning the giant hornet queen.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaNeedlesShakenOff: The giant hornet queen has shaken off all the lodged needles, drawing a swarm of titanic hornets toward the colony.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaNeedleActivated: Awakened by {PAWN_labelShort}, the ancient needle takes aim at the giant hornet queen.
LanguageData.VV_Speech_AsphodelRebirth1: ...No... not alone... I'll crumble, just like that day...
LanguageData.VV_Speech_AsphodelRebirth2: ...Before they're hurt... all of them... into my embrace...
LanguageData.VV_Speech_AsphodelDeath: ...The weight... into flowers... within this shade... my children, now...
LanguageData.VV_Letter_AsphodelFallen: "{QUOTE}"\n\nAs the fairy vivis around her came unbound, Asphodel's form dissolved into golden petals and drifted toward the everflower.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_FairyFlowerBound: Vivis near the fairy bloom lost their sense of self, turning into fairies and being drawn into Asphodel's embrace.\n\n{PAWNS}
LanguageData.VV_Letter_ApocryphaEmbrace: Vivis near the fairy bloom lost their sense of self, turning into fairies and being drawn into Asphodel's embrace.\n\n{PAWNS}
LanguageData.VV_Letter_AsphodelReleased: The vivis bound in Asphodel's embrace have been freed from their fairy form and returned to their true forms before the everflower.\n\n{PAWNS}
